source: Create a fully functional, polished first person extraction shooter game in Roblox Build inspired by Call of Duty and modern tactical extraction titles. Include these core features: fast fluid movement, high quality gunplay with realistic recoil, aim down sights, reloading, and weapon customization. Add a loadout system where players can choose primary weapons, secondary weapons, tactical gear, and armor before deploying. Design large detailed open combat zones with industrial areas, urban districts, and hidden loot spots. Include AI enemy combatants, valuable loot crates, and a clear match flow: spawn in, complete objectives, gather resources, fight off threats, and reach a designated extraction point within a limited time. Add risk versus reward mechanics where players lose all items if they die before extracting. Include team support options, kill feed, match HUD, and mobile friendly touch controls. Keep visuals gritty, modern, and immersive with smooth performance.

image_prompt.text: Warehouses, factory blocks and city buildings entered from the street, with loot worth going inside for
an industrial district of yards, silos and loading bays, and a separate urban district of streets and alleys, connected across one contiguous map
a marked extraction point at the edge of the map with several approaches to it
concealed loot spots tucked out of the obvious routes - back rooms, roof access, behind stacked crates

layout_placement.text: Weapons, gear and valuable crates distributed across the map in both obvious and hidden places
A play boundary that contracts over the match
Where AI combatants enter and the ground they patrol, sited so a player can read where trouble comes from
The extraction point - reaching it inside the time limit ends the run and banks everything carried

notes: Preset caveat: Battle Royale was the closest preset by shape, but an extraction shooter is not a battle royale. Its contracting boundary is kept per instruction and flagged as contradicted; the match is bounded by a timer and an exit, not a closing ring.
The extraction point is the objective the whole mode is named for and no option covers it. Carried as a null-id trigger.
Most of this prompt is not layout: gunplay, recoil, loadouts, HUD, kill feed and mobile controls all sit outside what this handoff can carry.
At the scale asked for - large open zones plus interiors - a single framed image will not hold the interior detail; the interiors are a separate P3 pass.

open_questions.ask: How large is 'large' - a couple of city blocks and one industrial yard, or something you need a vehicle to cross?
One extraction point or several, and are they fixed or do they move each match?
Is this PvPvE, or purely players against AI?

theme: Modern Urban - gritty contemporary industrial and city, realistic and grounded

coverage_missing.ask: How big should the map be, and is it crossed on foot?
How many extraction points, and are they fixed or rotating?
Do players fight each other, or only the AI?
Which real-world setting - post-Soviet industrial, generic modern city, something else?

answers.ask: How large is 'large' - a couple of city blocks and one industrial yard, or something you need a vehicle to cross?
answers.answer: Use a compact large combat zone: a couple of urban city blocks connected to one detailed industrial yard, traversable on foot without vehicles.

answers.ask: One extraction point or several, and are they fixed or do they move each match?
answers.answer: Use several fixed extraction points around the map so players have tactical choices without adding moving extraction logic.

answers.ask: Is this PvPvE, or purely players against AI?
answers.answer: Make it PvPvE: players can fight AI combatants and each other while competing for loot and extraction.
